mission: 教材仕様→問題UI→画像照合→生成→QA公開
mode: checkpointed sequential image generation, one image per subject
retryPolicy: failed QA target only; reuse verified assets
toolOutput: only summary and paths; large data stays in tool orchestration/files
releaseGate: V3 physical iOS10 is UNVERIFIED and blocks release unless explicit exemption
continuation: read CHECKPOINT and manifest; never restart passed assets
previewPolicy: no large preview output during production; final contact sheet only
searchPolicy: research complete; fetch new sources only for concrete unresolved facts
progressPolicy: persist every returned image immediately; summary at each batch
streaming: previous monolithic 106-request queue stopped after saved outputs; delivery root cause unverified
waitPolicy: yield immediately after launch; wait at most 30s; report pending state at 60s; save each result atomically
controllerPolicy: bounded 4-step window, select next item only after previous save, yield to client at every step; no bulk preloaded queue
